lead.headline: Allen throws for 81 yards in the rain; down 61.4 to 3.5
lead.deck: A 3.5-point night from your quarterback, two DNPs for Tuten, two limited days for Likely. The Sunday fallbacks stand.
lead.body: Bad news first. Josh Allen went 10 of 21 for 81 yards with two interceptions in Buffalo's 13-10 win over Kansas City, a cold downpour of a game — his worst passing line of the year — and scored 3.5 against 18.3 projected. No injury: a bad night, not an exit. Footballers lead 61.4 to 3.5 after Emmett Johnson's 19.6. Bhayshul Tuten has not practised all week, and Isaiah Likely was limited twice; Friday's reports come this afternoon. Pittsburgh made Mason Rudolph their starter for the rest of the season after releasing Aaron Rodgers, and Jaylen Warren plays Denver at 14:00 today. Sunday's plan is unchanged: if Tuten sits, Ollie Gordon II to RB and Stefon Diggs to FLEX; if Likely sits, add T.J. Hockenson and drop Travis Etienne Jr. ESPN gives you 32%.
